title: 30-Inch Solid Brass Wall-Mount Towel Bar | Lavender | Que New Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop towels from piling up on the vanity—hang bath towels where you need them with a wall-mounted towel bar designed to keep your bathroom organized in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat.

  • Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Space-smart wall mounting with a straight bar profile—ideal for busy bathrooms
  • Coordinated look across your bath as part of the Que New collection with distinctive circular detailing for matching Que New pieces
  • Style flexibility with multiple designer finish options, including statement colors

Specs & Installation

  • Collection: Que New (transitional)
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting
  • Center-to-center: 30 in
  • Dimensions: 30 in L x 33 in W x 3 in H; projection 3 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.5 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware (#8 x 1 1/4" screws)
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
